summary: Iteration 14 full-stack test of new features: category filters, launch-day switch (pre-launch state on 2026-09-11), bestseller badges, and image overhaul. Backend pytest: 20 passed, 1 skipped (no /api/admin/products endpoint - expected). All 37 products carry a category field with expected distribution (Gummies:15, Oils & Drops:8, Smokes:4, Kits & Combos:4, Tablets & Capsules:3, Topicals:2, Pet Care:1). All 37 image paths are local /brand-assets/... (no http URLs). Exactly 4 products flagged bestseller matching spec (moon-impact-stellardust, trost-mello-13-blueberry, cannazo-uplift-mango, cannazo-revive-roll-on). Frontend /shop renders type-filters row with all 8 chips and correct counts; brand+type combinations work (Trost+Smokes=4 products; Moon Impact+Smokes=0 with no-products-note shown). ProductDetail for cannazo-revive-roll-on shows BESTSELLER chip and 'TOPICALS' category in the brand line. Bestseller badges appear on the 4 correct product cards and NOT on non-bestsellers (trost-boom card verified clean). Homepage pre-launch state confirmed: navbar announcement 'Trost opens its own store tomorrow - Saturday, 12 September 2026 - Richmond Town, Bangalore' and trost-launch-section shows 'Trost opens its doors.', OPENING DAY card with 'Saturday, 12 September 2026', and VISIT THE STORE button. Cart add + /checkout renders line item 'Revive Pain Roll-On' at Rs.499. Admin login (admin@cosmoscure.in / Cosmos@2026) works, dashboard shows PRODUCTS: 37, and edit dialog for Stellardust shows Category select (value=Gummies) and Bestseller checkbox (checked). No console errors on home/shop/product/checkout pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Nice UX: Shop type-filter chips auto-hide zero-count categories per selected brand (e.g. Moon Impact hides Oils & Drops chip since count=0). This deviates slightly from the review request wording ('combining Moon Impact + type-filter-oils-drops shows the empty note') because the chip is not clickable in that state - but the equivalent empty state (no-products-note 'Nothing in this combination yet - try another type.') is still correctly shown for zero-result brand+type combos (verified Moon Impact + Smokes). Consider if the auto-hide is preferred over always-render+disable for accessibility discoverability.
Admin Edit/New product uses a single shared ProductForm - both dialogs contain product-field-category and product-field-bestseller as required.
seed_data_creation: None; server startup sync (CATEGORY_BY_SLUG, BESTSELLER_SLUGS, CUTOUT_SLUGS) applied cleanly to existing 37 products.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Shop uses data-testid=type-filters container with chips type-filter-{slug}. ProductCard bestseller badges are data-testid=bestseller-badge-{slug}. ProductDetail bestseller chip is data-testid=product-bestseller-badge. Admin login has data-testid=admin-email/admin-password/admin-login-btn; tabs are tab-products etc; edit buttons are data-testid=edit-{slug}; add is add-product-btn. Note: many buttons/announcement/text use CSS text-transform:uppercase so plain string matching on innerText requires .lower() or case-insensitive checks. Category/Bestseller only present in the shared ProductForm; both Edit and New reuse it. Home trost-launch-section (not 'trost-launch') is the actual data-testid.
rca of the issue: N/A - all features working as specified
